correctness.rationale: The cyclic parity relation P_k[2j]=0 and P_k[2j+1]=1-P_(k-1)[j] is well-defined modulo the even circumference. It rules out 11 and, because two consecutive odd-position zeros would require a lower-level 11, also rules out 0000. The remaining length-four palindromes require either 11 or ones at opposite parities, so no longer even palindrome can exist by its central four letters. The 00 factor exists for k>=2. Directly P_2=0100 gives {0,1,00,000,010}. For odd centers on odd positions, the reflection forces equality exactly on the sampled lower-level odd palindrome; mandatory zeros yield the two lifts. An odd lower-level length m is at most 2^(k-1)-1, so both lifts fit within one traversal. They are injective and separated by lengths 1 and 3 modulo 4. For an even-position center, agreement of its two adjacent odd-position letters requires adjacent lower-level zeros (11 is absent), giving 101 and its forced zero-extension 01010. Length seven would need a lower-level four-letter palindrome; both shorter exceptions occur because lower-level 00 exists. Neither exception can match the fixed-zero positions of the same-length odd-center lifts; the even-center singleton 0 is already a lift. Thus h_k=3+2(h_(k-1)-1), and the two lift lengths and exceptional lengths give precisely the asserted histogram recurrences including zero above the cap. The frozen checker and its rank-2–9 scope were inspected, not executed; the unrestricted conclusion follows by parity and induction.

Schaeffer–Shallit give lengths of maximal palindromes in the infinite coding. Barro et al. Theorems 3.1–3.2 treat lifting/desubstitution in the generalized infinite word. originality.rationale: The distinct claim is the rank-by-rank binary finite cyclic language with a one-traversal cap, not the morphic lift operators, the ban on long even palindromes, or the infinite palindromic complexity. Indeed the known transforms removing the first 0 of mu(v) and appending a 0 to mu(v) are exactly Phi and Psi; even the two odd exceptions are these transforms applied to 00. What is not supplied by the inspected earlier results is the sharp correspondence between occurrences on adjacent finite circles, with exact cap and all finite ranks. Infinite occurrence does not determine occurrence at a given finite rank. The strongest accessible finite-factor work is assessed on its actual linear or infinite-word statements, and the catalogue comparisons on their actual word families and statistics.
